spine: 1. pgrust 0.2 三個headline數字：比前一版快 10 倍、OLTP 比 Postgres 快 30%、ClickBench 分析查詢比 Postgres 快 300 倍；查詢引擎本身貢獻了 300 倍裡的約 10 倍。
2. Postgres 誕生於 1980 年代磁碟 I/O 是瓶頸的年代；現在資料集常駐記憶體、NVMe 比硬碟快上百倍，CPU／記憶體頻寬才是新瓶頸，這是全篇「還有多少空間可以壓榨」的前提。
3. 起點是一個迷你 Volcano 模型查詢引擎：SeqScan.next() 一次只回傳一列，SUM 5 億筆浮點數要 1.3 秒（真正的 Postgres 跑同一個查詢要 20 秒）。
4. 第一刀：批次化。next_batch() 一次搬 1024 列進堆疊上配置的緩衝區，時間砍到 480 毫秒。
5. 批次化之後熱點變成 copy_from_slice；把 SeqScan 跟 SumAggregate 融合成一個節點消掉這段複製，時間降到 358 毫秒——跟裸寫的 for 迴圈一樣快，因為編譯出來就是同一段程式碼。
6. 最後一刀是 ARM NEON SIMD：程式碼用四個累加器（[vdupq_n_f64(0.0); 4]）、每次迭代處理 8 個值，時間降到 135 毫秒，比裸 for 迴圈還快將近 3 倍，是原始 Volcano 版本的 10 倍。
7. 作者把 JIT compilation 留到下一篇——現在的算子融合是手刻的 scan+aggregate 特例，不是通用機制。

perspective.mechanism: Volcano 模型直譯器的逐行開銷（每個 plan node 一次 next() 呼叫回傳一列）在資料常駐記憶體時成為主導成本；批次化把呼叫次數攤薄、算子融合消掉節點之間的中間緩衝複製、SIMD（ARM NEON，4 個並行累加器）讓單一 CPU 指令同時處理多個值——三層各自打掉同一種直譯器稅的不同部位。
perspective.tradeoff: 算子融合目前是針對已知常見組合（scan+sum）手刻的特例節點，不是通用機制；作者明確把「pgrust 如何用 JIT compilation 解這個問題」留到下一篇，暗示沒有 JIT，融合沒辦法擴展到任意算子組合。
perspective.reader_use: 跑大型記憶體內 SUM／聚合查詢的工程師可以把這篇當心智模型：瓶頸不是磁碟 I/O，是逐行直譯器開銷；這決定了要不要考慮向量化／欄式引擎，或至少重新檢視現有查詢是否卡在 tuple-at-a-time 執行。

notes.quote: Last week we released version 0.2 of pgrust. This release was all about performance. It's 10x faster than the previous version of pgrust. On OLTP benchmarks, pgrust is 30% faster than Postgres, and on Clickbench, Clickhouse's benchmark for analytical databases, pgrust is 300x faster than Postgres. It's even ahead of Clickhouse!
notes.interpretation: 版本 0.2 的三個headline 數字：比前一版 pgrust 快 10 倍、OLTP 比 Postgres 快 30%、ClickBench 分析查詢比 Postgres 快 300 倍（甚至贏過 ClickHouse）。

notes.quote: The query engine is one of the biggest changes we made to achieve much better performance. On its own, the query engine drove ~10x of the 300x.
notes.interpretation: 查詢引擎的優化單獨貢獻了 300 倍裡大約 10 倍；其餘倍數來自別的改動（本文不展開）。

notes.quote: To give some background on why there's so much room for improvement vs Postgres, Postgres was created in a different era. The original Postgres project dates back to the 80s. It was built at a time when the main bottleneck to database performance was disk I/O. Three trends have made that no longer the case: 1. Many datasets now fit in RAM, eliminating most disk I/O 2. For datasets that don't fit in RAM, the workloads differ. Data analytics scans data in bulk. The bottleneck is often no longer your disk throughput and is often either your CPU throughput or memory throughput 3. Disks have gotten much faster in recent years. NVMe is hundreds of times faster than a hard drive.
notes.interpretation: 作者的框架：Postgres 誕生於磁碟 I/O 是瓶頸的 1980 年代；現在資料集常駐記憶體、分析工作負載是大量掃描（CPU／記憶體頻寬才是瓶頸）、NVMe 比硬碟快上百倍——三個趨勢共同解釋了為什麼還有這麼多優化空間。

notes.quote: When I run this example, it takes 1.3s.
notes.interpretation: 迷你 Volcano 模型基線（SUM 5 億筆浮點數）跑 1.3 秒。

notes.quote: There's no batching. The `SeqScan.next()` function is called once per row.
notes.interpretation: Volcano 基線沒有批次化，SeqScan.next() 每一列呼叫一次。

notes.quote: The job of `next()` is to return a single row. `next()` in a sequential scan returns the next row in the sequential scan. `next()` on an aggregation will compute the entire aggregation and then return the single row result.
notes.interpretation: Volcano／iterator 模型的定義：每個節點的 next() 只回傳一列，由父節點遞迴往上拉，這個逐行呼叫開銷正是後續三個優化要打掉的東西。

notes.quote: Batching on its own eliminates most of the overhead. It brings the time to run the query from 1.3 seconds down to around 480ms.
notes.interpretation: 批次化把時間從 1.3 秒降到約 480 毫秒（原文用「around」帶一點誤差空間）。

notes.quote: const BATCH: usize = 1024;
notes.interpretation: 批次大小是程式碼常數 1024 列。

notes.quote: fn next_batch(&mut self, out: &mut [f64; BATCH]) -> usize
notes.interpretation: batching 版本用 next_batch() 取代 next()，一次把整批資料寫進呼叫端提供的陣列，回傳實際填入的列數（usize），而不是一次回傳一列。

notes.quote: One very important detail is that the batch buffer is allocated on the stack.
notes.interpretation: 批次緩衝區配置在堆疊上，而非每批次動態配置堆積記憶體。

notes.quote: Now, if you profile the batched version, the hotspot is now `copy_from_slice`. Even though we are now batching, we still need to copy the items into the buffer. This overhead can be eliminated with what's known as 'operator fusion'.
notes.interpretation: 批次化之後新的熱點是把資料複製進緩衝區的 copy_from_slice；算子融合的動機正是要消掉這段複製。

notes.quote: The query takes 358ms.
notes.interpretation: 裸寫的 Rust for 迴圈（未經任何 Volcano 抽象）跑同一個 SUM 只要 358 毫秒——這是後續融合節點要追平的目標值。

notes.quote: This gives us the same performance as the straight for loop because it is literally the same code as the for loop.
notes.interpretation: 把 SeqScan 和 SumAggregate 融合成一個節點後，效能追平裸 for 迴圈的 358 毫秒，因為編譯後產生的是同一份程式碼——抽象開銷完全消失。

notes.quote: For one final optimization, we can look to SIMD. SIMD refers to a set of CPU operations that can perform one operation across multiple pieces of data simultaneously. Using SIMD to perform an operation against multiple rows simultaneously is usually much faster than performing the operation on one row at a time.
notes.interpretation: 第三刀是 SIMD：單一 CPU 指令同時對多筆資料做同一個運算，通常比逐列處理快得多。

notes.quote: use std::arch::aarch64::*; ... let mut acc = unsafe { [vdupq_n_f64(0.0); 4] };
notes.interpretation: SIMD 實作用 ARM AArch64 的 NEON intrinsics，宣告了一個長度 4 的累加器陣列（四個 128-bit NEON 暫存器，各自初始化為 0）。

notes.quote: .as_chunks::<8>() ... vld1q_f64 ... vaddq_f64 ... vaddvq_f64
notes.interpretation: 輸入資料以每 8 個 f64 為一組切塊處理，用 vld1q_f64 載入、vaddq_f64 做向量加法、迴圈結束後用 vaddvq_f64 把四個累加器內的值疊加成單一總和——四個累加器、每次迭代處理 8 個值。為什麼要四個累加器而非一個，原文沒有明講；合理的推測是為了打斷加總運算的資料相依鏈，讓 NEON 管線能同時處理多筆加法而不必等前一筆算完。

notes.quote: Our code now takes 135ms which is now almost 3x faster than the for loop and 10x faster than our original Volcano code.
notes.interpretation: SIMD 版本跑 135 毫秒，比裸 for 迴圈快將近 3 倍，比最初的 Volcano 版本快 10 倍（1.3s / 135ms ≈ 9.6x，作者取整數說 10 倍）。

notes.quote: When I run this in Postgres, it takes ~20 seconds.
notes.interpretation: 同一個查詢在真正的 Postgres 上跑要約 20 秒——比迷你 Volcano 基線（1.3 秒）還慢十幾倍，更不用說最終的 135 毫秒。

notes.quote: Benchmark setup: AWS c8g.4xlarge (Graviton4, 16 vCPU), PostgreSQL 18.4 with `max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0`, data warm in shared buffers, median of 5 runs. Rust built with `cargo build --release`, 4 runs per implementation, all measured in one process on one machine.
notes.interpretation: 測試環境：AWS c8g.4xlarge（Graviton4，16 vCPU）；Postgres 18.4 關掉平行 worker（max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0）、資料已預熱在 shared buffers；Postgres 取 5 次跑的中位數，Rust 各版本各跑 4 次、同一台機器單一 process 量測——run 數不多，是部落格級別的基準測試而非嚴謹統計研究。

notes.quote: CREATE TABLE my_table AS select col::float8 from generate_series(1.0, 500000000.0)
notes.interpretation: 測試資料表是 5 億筆 float8，查詢是對這個欄位做 SELECT SUM(col)——刻意設計成 CPU／記憶體密集而非磁碟 I/O 密集，用來單獨凸顯查詢引擎本身的開銷。

notes.quote: Unfortunately, this post is long enough as is, so I'll have to talk about how pgrust leverages JIT compilation another time.
notes.interpretation: 作者明確表示 JIT compilation 留到未來的文章再談——暗示目前示範的算子融合是手刻特例，通用化需要 JIT。

notes.quote: All in all, with three simple optimizations, we were able to make our query 10x faster. Here's where things ended up: [table] Postgres ~20s — ; Volcano model 1.3s 1x; + batching 480ms 2.7x; + operator fusion 358ms 3.6x; + SIMD 135ms 9.6x
notes.interpretation: 文末的總結表格用「相對 Volcano 基線的倍數」呈現同一組數字：批次化 2.7 倍、算子融合 3.6 倍、SIMD 9.6 倍——跟前面各段落用毫秒描述的是同一組量測，只是換了一種累計倍數的呈現方式。

notes.quote: Allocating memory tends to be one of the slower operations. Therefore, when writing ultra-fast code, you'll want to minimize the number of memory allocations you make.
notes.interpretation: 解釋批次緩衝區為什麼配置在堆疊上而非堆積：記憶體配置本身是相對慢的操作，寫追求極致速度的程式碼要盡量減少配置次數。

notes.quote: If you're curious two of the biggest causes of overhead from Postgres are 1. locking and 2. parsing the Postgres storage format and extracting the tuples relevant to the query
notes.interpretation: 原文自己點名 Postgres 兩個最大的開銷來源：鎖，以及解析 Postgres 儲存格式、從中抽出查詢用得到的 tuple。這兩項都不是批次化／算子融合／SIMD 拿掉的東西，所以 20 秒與 1.3 秒之間的落差不能算到這三刀頭上。
notes.checker_note: Added in Step 7.6c to close the trace failures on c03 and c01; quote re-verified verbatim against the source in the round-2 re-check.

claims.evidence: Batching on its own eliminates most of the overhead. It brings the time to run the query from 1.3 seconds down to around 480ms.
claims.note: The source's 'around' survives as 約 in prose; the widget shows a bare 480 ms per chart convention.

claims.claim_text: 批次緩衝區配置在堆疊上……配置記憶體本身是相對慢的操作
claims.location: H2「批次化」第一、二段
claims.evidence: One very important detail is that the batch buffer is allocated on the stack. / Allocating memory tends to be one of the slower operations.
claims.note: The source's 'tends to be' is rendered as 相對慢的操作 — same strength.

claims.claim_text: 至於為什麼批次大小挑 1024……文章沒有解釋，合理的推測是……1024 個 f64 剛好是 8 KB
claims.location: H2「批次化」第二段
claims.note: Marked with 合理的推測是 and preceded by an explicit 「文章沒有解釋」. Re-verified: the source gives no L1/cache/8 KB reasoning. 1024 x 8 bytes = 8 KB is arithmetic over the sourced constant.

claims.claim_text: profiler 顯示熱點變成 copy_from_slice
claims.location: H2「算子融合」第一段；並見 stage-slider
claims.evidence: Now, if you profile the batched version, the hotspot is now `copy_from_slice`. Even though we are now batching, we still need to copy the items into the buffer. This overhead can be eliminated with what's known as 'operator fusion'.
claims.note: Exactly what the source records.

claims.claim_text: 融合後的節點跑 358 毫秒，跟一段裸寫的 for 迴圈一模一樣快；作者給的理由很直白：編譯出來本來就是同一段程式碼
claims.location: H2「算子融合」第一段；並見 stage-slider 與 3D 堆疊
claims.evidence: The query takes 358ms. / This gives us the same performance as the straight for loop because it is literally the same code as the for loop. / + operator fusion 358ms 3.6x
claims.note: The 358 ms first appears for the raw for loop and is confirmed for the fused node by the summary table, so the juxtaposition is correct.

claims.claim_text: 程式碼宣告了一個長度 4 的累加器陣列……用 vld1q_f64 載入、vaddq_f64 做向量加法……再用 vaddvq_f64 把四個累加器的值疊成單一總和
claims.location: H2「SIMD：NEON 的四個累加器」第一、二段
claims.evidence: use std::arch::aarch64::*; ... let mut acc = unsafe { [vdupq_n_f64(0.0); 4] }; / .as_chunks::<8>() ... vld1q_f64 ... vaddq_f64 ... vaddvq_f64
claims.note: All five identifiers plus the four-accumulator / 8-values-per-iteration structure are in the source's code block. The 128-bit register width is the post's architectural gloss, low-load and not separately claimed.

claims.claim_text: 文章沒有明講為什麼要四個累加器而不是一個——合理的推測是為了打斷加總運算本身的資料相依鏈
claims.location: H2「SIMD」第一段
claims.note: Marked with 合理的推測是 and preceded by 「文章沒有明講」. Re-verified: the source has only the code, with no discussion of dependency chains or instruction-level parallelism.

claims.claim_text: 這一刀把時間壓到 135 毫秒，比裸 for 迴圈還快將近 3 倍，是最初 Volcano 版本的 10 倍。
claims.location: H2「SIMD」第一段；並見多個 widget 與表格
claims.evidence: Our code now takes 135ms which is now almost 3x faster than the for loop and 10x faster than our original Volcano code.
claims.note: 'almost 3x' / '10x' map to 將近 3 倍 / 10 倍. Note the 10x baseline here is the 1.3 s Volcano version, not the 20 s Postgres — the exact distinction c01 got wrong.

claims.claim_text: 不是毫秒，是相對 Volcano 基線的累計倍數：批次化 2.7 倍、加上算子融合 3.6 倍、加上 SIMD 9.6 倍。
claims.location: H2「SIMD」之後、結語前的收束段
claims.evidence: All in all, with three simple optimizations, we were able to make our query 10x faster. … Volcano model 1.3s 1x; + batching 480ms 2.7x; + operator fusion 358ms 3.6x; + SIMD 135ms 9.6x
claims.note: Three cumulative multiples verified cell by cell, and this sentence correctly names the baseline.

claims.claim_text: 300 倍裡剩下沒被這三刀解釋到的部分，大約還有 30 倍——文章沒有說這 30 倍從哪裡來，多半是儲存格式、交易層或別的子系統的改動
claims.location: 結語前的收束段
claims.note: 30x is 300 / 10 over two sourced operands. The round-2 re-check noted that the source does gesture at the remainder ('These types of optimizations, and many more, enable pgrust to perform hundreds of times faster') and that 多半是 was doing hedge duty without an explicit marker. FIXED: now says the article mentions 「許多其他」 optimizations without naming them, and marks the guess with 合理的推測是.

claims.claim_text: 在 ClickHouse 的分析型基準 ClickBench 上比 Postgres 快 300 倍——甚至贏過 ClickHouse 本身
claims.location: 正文第一段；並重複於 tooltip 與量測方法段
claims.evidence: on Clickbench, Clickhouse's benchmark for analytical databases, pgrust is 300x faster than Postgres. It's even ahead of Clickhouse!
claims.note: Vendor self-reported performance claim from a single source; the post keeps visible attribution (「headline 數字」/「作者還特別提了一句」) and adds its own single-benchmark caveat, which deflates rather than inflates.
